title: Dangote’s Namibia Launch: Why I Doubt an All-Electric Future
standfirst: From Namibia’s proposed fuel network to Kenya’s revived Turkana pipeline plan, battery affordability and Europe’s demand for sustainable fuels strengthen my case for a future beyond batteries alone.
seo_title: Dangote’s Namibia Launch, EVs and Africa’s Biofuel Future
seo_description: Waithaka Ndegwa examines Dangote’s Namibia launch, Kenya’s Turkana pipeline proposal, EV challenges, Europe’s biofuel demand and Crostar Energy’s aims.
